    mask = cloud.Or(cirrus).Not()
    return img.updateMask(mask)

def add_s2_indices(img):
    blue = img.select('B2').multiply(0.0001)
    green = img.select('B3').multiply(0.0001)
    red = img.select('B4').multiply(0.0001)
    nir = img.select('B8').multiply(0.0001)
    vis = blue.add(green).add(red).divide(3).rename('vis')
    ndwi = green.subtract(nir).divide(green.add(nir)).rename('ndwi')
    return img.addBands([vis, ndwi])

def mask_ls(img):

    dilated = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 1).neq(0)
    cirrus = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 2).neq(0)
    cloud = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).neq(0)
    shadow = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).neq(0)
    mask = dilated.Or(cirrus).Or(cloud).Or(shadow).Not()
    return img.updateMask(mask)

def add_ls_indices(img):

    blue = img.select('SR_B2').multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2)
    green = img.select('SR_B3').multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2)
    red = img.select('SR_B4').multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2)
    nir = img.select('SR_B5').multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2)
    vis = blue.add(green).add(red).divide(3).rename('vis')
    ndwi = green.subtract(nir).divide(green.add(nir)).rename('ndwi')
    return img.addBands([vis, ndwi])

    # Try Sentinel-2 on exact date
    col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') \

    nir = img.select('B8').multiply(scale).rename('nir')
    swir = img.select('B11').multiply(scale)
    vis = blue.add(green).add(red).divide(3).rename('vis')
    mndwi = green.subtract(swir).divide(green.add(swir)).rename('mndwi')
    return img.addBands([vis, mndwi, nir])

def mask_ls(img):
    qa = img.select('QA_PIXEL')
    dilated = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 1).neq(0)
    cirrus = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 2).neq(0)
    cloud = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).neq(0)
    shadow = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).neq(0)
    mask = dilated.Or(cirrus).Or(cloud).Or(shadow).Not()
    return img.updateMask(mask)

def add_ls_indices(img):
    # reflectance = SR * 0.0000275 - 0.2
    def sc(b): return img.select(b).multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2)
    blue = sc('SR_B2'); green = sc('SR_B3'); red = sc('SR_B4'); nir = sc('SR_B5').rename('nir')
    swir = sc('SR_B6')
    vis = blue.add(green).add(red).divide(3).rename('vis')
    mndwi = green.subtract(swir).divide(green.add(swir)).rename('mndwi')
    return img.addBands([vis, mndwi, nir])

def get_dataset():
    # Sentinel-2 exact date
    col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') \
            .filterBounds(union_geom) \
            .filterDate(*date_main) \
            .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 95))
    if col.size().getInfo() > 0:
        return ('S2', date_main, col)
    # Sentinel-2 widened
    col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') \
            .filterBounds(union_geom) \
            .filterDate(*date_wide) \
            .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 95))
    if col.size().getInfo() > 0:
        return ('S2', date_wide, col)
    # Landsat exact date
    l8 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2').filterBounds(union_geom).filterDate(*date_main)
    l9 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2').filterBounds(union_geom).filterDate(*date_main)
    col = l8.merge(l9)
    if col.size().getInfo() > 0:
        return ('LS', date_main, col)
    # Landsat widened
    l8 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2').filterBounds(union_geom).filterDate(*date_wide)
    l9 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2').filterBounds(union_geom).filterDate(*date_wide)
    col = l8.merge(l9)
    if col.size().getInfo() > 0:
        return ('LS', date_wide, col)
    return (None, None, ee.ImageCollection([]))

def compute_counts_and_mean(img, roi, water_mask):
    vis = img.select('vis')
    vis_w = vis.updateMask(water_mask)
    count = vis_w.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry=roi,
        scale=1000,
        maxPixels=1e9,
    ).get('vis')
    mean_vis = vis_w.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry=roi,
        scale=1000,
        maxPixels=1e9,
    ).get('vis')
    return (count, mean_vis)

try:
    ds, daterange, col = get_dataset()

    if ds == 'S2':

        proc = col.map(mask_s2_sr).map(add_s2_indices).median()
    else:

        proc = col.map(mask_ls).map(add_ls_indices).median()

    m1 = proc.select('mndwi').gt(0.10)

    candidates = [
        ('mNDWI>0.10', m1),

    ]

    chosen = None
    for name, m in candidates:

        c_count = ee.Number(compute_counts_and_mean(proc, roi_cuy, wm)[0]).getInfo()

            e_vis = ee.Number(compute_counts_and_mean(proc, roi_con, wm)[1]).getInfo()
            chosen = (name, int(c_count), int(e_count), c_vis, e_vis)

    if chosen is None:
